title: Cut the lead session startup bundle below 8 kB
body:
Outcome: a lead session's startup Bash output (first 6 calls) falls from a median 25.7 kB to under 8 kB.
Why: the startup bundle is 13% of lead dollars since 2026-11-08 (662 turns, 2.74 MB over 99 sessions); sessions cat handoff.md, state.md, tasks/<id>.json and the PR template, and `krn state check` prints its full JSON report although --json exists (.krn/runs/roadmap-refill-3/session-cost.md).
Proof: SessionStart injects the resume task's title and body; `krn state check` prints a one-line verdict unless --json; krn-lead step 1 says the Verify is the only startup read; re-measure on 10 new sessions.
Scope: scripts/claude/context-restart.ts, src/cli/state.ts, .agents/skills/krn-lead/SKILL.md.
